.kitchen
Pyaj ki chatni resipi | vistrit photo aur vidiyo resipi ke sath idli dosa ke lie bahuuddeshiy bhartiy vengya chatni. lal pyaj ke slais ke sath taiyar ek behad saral aur sabhi uddeshyon vali masaledar masala chatni resipi. yah mul rup se masaledar achar resipi ka ek vistar hai jismen lagbhag saman buniyadi masale aur samagri hain. yah bahuuddeshyiy chatni hai aur chaval aur chapati ke sath dophar aur rat ke khane ke lie nahin to kisi bhi prakar ke subah dakshin bhartiy nashte ki resipi men aasani se parosa ja sakta hai.
